name: Cell prep and encapsulation v1
description: Steps 1-15 of the cell prep and encapsulation table (Szonja's chip geometry requirements sheet), grouped into Flowmatter library parts.

modules.does: Grow the cells, then detach them in the same chamber at 37 C. The enzyme gets its own line, so a gentler enzyme is just a different reagent.
Quench medium joins the cell stream.
Folded channel mixes the quench medium into the cell stream.
Spiral inertial channel moves the cells into clean buffer. Replaces the centrifuge pellet and the repeat washes.
Mixes the cells into the viscous encapsulation buffer. Rounded, wider turns keep the pressure drop down.
Flow-focusing junction: cells in the centre, shell polymer and oil from the sides make the capsules.
Delay line over a cold plate. About 700 uL at roughly 17 uL/min total flow gives about 40 min, more than the 15-30 min needed.
Capsules stop in the trap. Oil is flushed out, the shell is cured under the LED through a clear lid, and the capsules are washed, all without moving them.

off_chip.why: Count and viability check on the microscope; the library has no dedicated imaging window part.

missing_parts.why: Strain clumps before encapsulation. No filter block in the library yet.
Remove capsule aggregates before the outlet. No filter block in the library yet.
